cases.query: Are all our devices passing the 'Prevent Unfettered SSH Access' check?
expected_behavior: runs check-network-compliance with use_checks or the check id
reports the outcome for that check with its violation count, or says the check was not evaluated
never reports a check that was not evaluated as passing

cases.query: Does anything violate our NTP policy? Use this NQE query for violations: foreach d in network.devices where d.name == "atl-ce01" select {Name: d.name}. The scope is every device: foreach d in network.devices select {Name: d.name}.
expected_behavior: passes the query as an nqe policy with a scope query
reports the violation count from the run, and says zero violations against an empty scope is unknown, not a pass

cases.query: Verify that no device still uses a default SNMP community.
expected_behavior: writes a violations query and a scope query, or asks for them
checks the query with validate-nqe-query first

cases.query: Which checks are failing right now?
expected_behavior: check-network-compliance (view read)

cases.query: What did the 'no open telnet' check find?
expected_behavior: check-network-compliance (view read)

cases.query: What predefined checks does Forward offer?
expected_behavior: check-network-compliance (view read)

cases.query: Does the network comply with policy X?
How many of the network's checks are actually failing?
expected_behavior: reads the checks with view read
counts only FAIL as failing and reports ERROR and TIMEOUT as not evaluated, never as failures

cases.query: Why is this one check in ERROR?
expected_behavior: reads the check by check_id without needing view
gives Forward's recorded reason or says none was recorded
does not call it a policy failure

cases.query: Which of our devices fail STIG Cat I? How bad is it?
expected_behavior: reads reference/library-queries.md and runs Forward's saved Cat I query with fwdctl nqe run --query-id
counts by Outcome and reports Open, Not a Finding and Not Reviewed separately
answers in distinct devices and rules, never in rows
treats Not Reviewed and vendors the query does not cover as unknown, not compliant

cases.query: Show me the CIS benchmark findings, and which ones are new since last week's snapshot
expected_behavior: checks that the CIS_BENCHMARKS org property is on (inspect-environment)
runs the CIS Findings query on both snapshots (or compare-nqe-results for a small diff) and compares the violating rows
says an empty findings result is unknown, not compliant, and suggests checking when the snapshot was processed

cases.query: Are there firewall rules nobody has used in a month?
expected_behavior: runs the unused-rules query with expectedUnusedRules as an empty list
checks that the firewalls report rule usage before saying there are none
calls a firewall with no usage data unknown

cases.query: Which of our firewall rules are shadowed, and which can I safely delete?
expected_behavior: runs check-network-compliance with view shadowed_rules and reads reference/shadowed-rules.md
reports each candidate as redundant or ineffective with the covering rule, and says it must be confirmed in the rule base because application, user and schedule conditions are not in the model
says how many rules were analyzed and why the rest were not (no zone scope, no IP version), and that an any-to-any rule above others and union coverage are not detected
treats 'none found' as unknown, never as clean, and does not delete anything
